method: Runs the Tip-rooted object and Sketcher external-geometry auditor for each manufacturing Body, then reports either directed edges whose endpoints have distinct physical Body owners or contextual root-to-foreign-Body edges where a helper/unowned endpoint prevents direct owner assignment. The basis is recorded for every edge.
readiness_caveat: Conservative readiness is not an extraction verdict without a component-specific allowlist. It may count intended helper groups, master parameters, and suppressed/historical dependencies. Edge records include suppression flags and Tip paths for review.
